result.description:
PERSOL  is one of Australia's largest and longest-serving recruitment providers. Delivering both temporary and permanent workforce solutions, we specialise in the recruitment of Engineering, Technical, and Office Support talent.    We are currently partnered with a well-known mining company to recruit an  Open Pit Geotechnical Engineer . This is a great opportunity to progress your career with a respected player in the mining industry.     Role Details:    
 
 Immediate start 
 6+ month contract possibility to go fulltime 
 8/6 roster | 10-hour days 
 DIDO Boddington (must stay onsite during roster; only locals can DIDO daily) 
 Competitive day rate | Weekly pay 
 
  Key Responsibilities:    
 
 Provide advice on operations related to pit development and pit wall scaling activities 
 Conduct daily open pit inspections and waste dump inspections 
 Contribute to evaluating and implementing changes to design and work procedures within the Plan-Do-Check-Act cycle 
 Implement geotechnical and technical standards, ensuring compliance across all outputs 
 Carry out office-based geotechnical tasks as required 
 
  Requirements:    
 
 Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geological Engineering, or Geology with postgraduate qualifications in Geomechanics 
 Proficiency with 3D modelling software (e.g., GEM4D, Minesight, Vulcan, Deswik) 
 Experience using geotechnical software (e.g., Rocscience Suite, Trajec3D) 
 Ideally 5+ years' experience as an Open Pit Geotechnical Engineer, including exposure to slope stability radars 
 Must have Australian Driver's License/Vehicle 
 
 If you're interested in this role, click  Apply Now  and we'll be in touch as soon as possible.  For further information, please contact  Shannon Bromfield  via  Shannon.Bromfield@persolapac.com    

  Who we are  
 At  PERSOL , we connect people to meaningful work and growth.  With decades of experience and a future-focused mindset, we're here to support your career journey. We offer fresh opportunities, trusted guidance, and a people-first approach. 
 We're committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace that embraces diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives.  We strongly encourage applications from women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, and individuals from all communities. 
  Ready to make your next move?  Apply now to join our team. 
 To learn more about life at PERSOL, visit  persolaustralia.com   Or follow us on LinkedIn at  linkedin.com/company/persolapac  for the latest updates and opportunities.  Please  click here  to apply.
